node_label: Resumen regional escrito en la BD
cells:
sql = """
SELECT region, SUM(monto) AS total
INTO dbo.resumen_regional
FROM dbo.ventas
GROUP BY region
"""
with engine.begin() as conn:
    conn.execute(text(sql))
